Official structure

ESOL Reading Entry 2: qualification overview

Understand the Award, its single mandatory unit, assessment method and progression routes before you practise.

Official sources checked: 2026-09-19

Know the exact qualification

The Gateway Qualifications Entry Level Award in ESOL Skills for Life (Reading) (Entry 2) has qualification number 601/5416/0. It is separate from the Entry 2 Writing and Speaking and Listening Awards.

One mandatory reading unit

Learners complete M/506/8491 Reading Entry 2. The Award carries 6 credits and Gateway lists 60 guided learning hours and 60 total qualification hours.

01PURPOSE02CLUE03EVIDENCE04ANSWER

Task-based controlled assessment

The current qualification page describes task-based controlled assessment and Pass grading. Your approved centre conducts the assessment and follows Gateway's current quality-assurance arrangements.

Plan the next step

Possible progression includes a higher ESOL Reading level, another ESOL skill area, Entry 3 Functional Skills English, other Entry 3 qualifications or work towards GCSE English.
